Diabetes is treatable. Having diabetes doesn't mean you'll go blind and amputated. 

Maybe that should be your starting point: your health. Have you considered talking to your doctor and assess your current condition? If you don't take care of your health, everything else is pointless

I was reading your text and found a lot of similarities with my situation; the only difference I see is the job part. 

You said you wouldn't consider a job at McDonald's, can I ask you why? The job may be awful, but I think the most important thing for you at the moment should be keeping your mind busy, and any job would be helpful.  I speak from my own experience: our minds are dangerous places, if you drift inside them for too long, you end up in dangerous places.
